events.meaning: Order and State/Federation Agreements came into operation; agreement signing on 21 January is distinct.
Formal founding through adoption of constitution at the congress/general assembly, Istana Besar Johor Bahru.
Outbreak at 2 a.m., per contemporary British ministerial statement.
events.remaining: TNKU versus Sultan’s police and British reinforcements is supported as the British government account. Azahari’s own proclamation has not been directly read; do not present disputed motives as settled facts.
The original appointment instrument and oath text remain unread; names and portfolios use the separate ISEAS finding aid.

events.meaning: Construction interval for the original mosque; no exact day claimed.
events.remaining: The current building is a later replacement; do not date its fabric to 1824.

events.meaning: British/EIC taking of Prince of Wales Island, not first settlement.
events.remaining: Original journal/instrument not read. Existing Malay settlements predated EIC possession.

events.meaning: Population reference night. Enumeration was taken on 2 April as at midnight the previous night.
events.remaining: SSO direct page remains 403. The contemporary report passage was read as reproduced OCR, not a visually inspected scan. If the event means enumeration activity, label it 2 April; if the census reference date, use 1 April.

events.meaning: First timber palace with attap roofs completed in 1819.
events.remaining: This is not the extant palace: the institutional account dates commissioning of the present building after Tunku Ali’s return in 1840.

events.meaning: Relocation of the Temenggong’s Istana/settlement to Telok Blangah.
events.remaining: Exact day and original relocation order remain unread.

events.meaning: Beginning of the first investigation, reported as 18–28 January 1984.
events.remaining: The original 1985 field report remains unread; the year is secure at institutional level.

events.meaning: 1876 Protection Ordinance, Singapore operation from 1883 and replacement in 1884 are different milestones.
events.remaining: Original ordinances and G.N. 577 of 28 December 1883 still need inspection; do not assign an exact commencement date from this secondary article.

events.meaning: Sultan’s relocation to Tanjung Batu and construction of Kota Johor Lama, per Malaysia Museums.
events.remaining: Exact day and contemporary instrument not read; precise point coordinate remains unverified.

events.meaning: Marriage gift to Engku Puteri Raja Hamidah and development of the island as government centre, per the heritage decision.
events.remaining: Earlier defensive use is recorded in 1782–1784; do not call 1803 the first settlement. Original marriage/development instrument not read.

events.meaning: Transfer of the royal government from Hulu Riau to Daik, per the heritage decision.
events.remaining: This dates royal relocation, not first habitation. Exact day and contemporary instrument not read.

events.meaning: Portuguese capture of Malacca, per the Portuguese Navy museum account.
events.remaining: This is not the foundation of the already established trading port. Original 1511 account/instrument and exact site coordinate not inspected.

events.meaning: Signature of the proclamation establishing BMA in areas under Allied forces’ control.
events.remaining: 12 September is the surrender/return chapter anchor. Proclamation signature on 15 August and Gazette reproduction on 1 November are confirmed; the precise assumption-of-control milestone for Singapore remains unverified.
